title: ashishpatel26/500-AI-Agents-Projects: a catalog of agent ideas, not an agent
friendlyTitle: 500 AI Agents Projects is a list of examples, not one agent
summary: 500 AI Agents Projects is a curated list of agent use cases, grouped by industry, with links to open-source implementations. It is not one tool you run. It gained about 110 stars on GitHub's daily trending list, with about 39,600 in total. The license is MIT. The latest commit on the default branch was 6 November.
